# add askgit

Add [askgit](https://github.com/askgitdev/askgit) — SQL queries over git history (commits, files, blame), later renamed MergeStat — to the toolset; another "SQL for everything" tool next to `octosql` ([#97](DOT-96.md)) and `osquery` ([#103](DOT-102.md)).
